notes:
{卵|たまご} means egg, typically chicken eggs. Also means 'novice' or 'aspiring' when used figuratively.

WRITING:
- {卵|たまご}: general term for eggs (including biological context)
- {玉子|たまご}: specifically chicken eggs used in cooking

COMMON PREPARATIONS:
- ⟦{目玉焼|めだまや}き→目玉焼き：14946_medamayaki⟧: fried egg (sunny-side up)
- ⟦{卵焼|たまごや}き→卵焼き：10367_tamagoyaki⟧: Japanese rolled omelet
- ⟦ゆで{卵|たまご}→ゆで卵：10651_yudetamago⟧: boiled egg
- ⟦{生|なま}{卵|たまご}→生卵：19011_namatamago⟧: raw egg
- ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧{卵|たまご}: soft-boiled onsen egg

〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{卵|たまご} means an aspiring or novice ~:
